title: Coming to Europe in September 2019?

body:
I’ve been receiving a number of inquiries to speak in Europe, but have not been able to say yes due to other commitments. So we’re considering a speaking tour in Europe from 3-21 September, 2019.

 If your organization would be interested in having me come, would you contact us ASAP? You may be interested in a day-long conference, a multi-day retreat, or an evening speaking engagement, etc. No obligation, of course, but if you contact Laci (who manages my schedule) ASAP, she can fill you in on logistics and begin building a schedule. (If that time frame is not suitable for you, please let us now as well. Thanks!)

 Click here.
